events.name: ATM Christmas Wish
events.description: In a parked car on a snowy day, someone presses their hands together and makes a Christmas wish, eyes shut; then a black-and-white security camera shows a cash machine that won't stop pouring out money, and they dive into the pile and come up with a bundle of notes in their mouth.

events.name: Oh My Carne Asada Singing Dog
events.description: Your dog or cat on a green screen throws its head back for a long howl, then stares into the camera with huge round eyes and sings the 'oh my carne asada' chant, ending on a sly grin.

events.name: Deck the Halls Dance
events.description: In a kitchen at night you jump into frame in an all-black outfit and white socks and dance the fast fist-pumping Deck the Halls routine straight to the phone, with a hair-whipping spin and a low wide-legged finish.

events.name: Dip On Em Dance
events.description: Two friends in matching leopard tracksuits do the Dip On Em dance in a bright airport hall: side hops, hands clapping overhead, a hand to the brow, then the low dip.

events.name: Dog Drummer
events.description: Your dog or cat pours a bottle of water over the drum, flicks the bottle away and smashes out a drum solo with water exploding off every hit. Or you do.

events.name: Düğün Oyunu
events.description: Two friends go wild on a lit Turkish wedding dance floor: shoulder shimmies face to face round the davul drummer, then side by side bouncing with their arms up, and a guest in a white vest leans into the phone laughing at the end.

events.name: Goodbye GTA 5: Desert Highway
events.description: You drive an old white convertible down a desert highway at sunset while a biker, a man in a suit and a man in a red pickup wave you off; you laugh until you cry, take the fork alone and pass the Vice City road sign.

events.name: GTA 6 Airboat Escape
events.description: You and your crew on a swamp airboat at sunset in a game-style chase: police boats in the reeds behind you, an alligator lunging at the side, a jump off a mud bank against a huge sun, a high five, and the boat racing off down the channel.

events.name: GTA 6 Busted? Not Today
events.description: Pulled over on a night highway in a game-style scene: the picture slows and goes black and white on your face as the officer leans in, then the colour snaps back, you grin, and the convertible takes off in a cloud of tyre smoke.

events.name: GTA 6 Cheat Code
events.description: Cornered by police on a sunset palm-tree street in blocky old-console game graphics, you punch a cheat code into a flip phone, the cubes burst, and the game snaps to next-gen: a stunned officer, then you, real and sharp, rising from behind a car with the gun up.

events.name: GTA 6 Getaway Duo
events.description: A game-style getaway in 12 seconds: two people stroll up to a gas-station store under a pink sunset, pull navy bandanas up, run out with a duffel bag, pile into a black muscle car, tug the bandanas down and laugh through the windscreen as police cars give chase down a palm-lined road.

events.name: GTA 6 Vice City Arrival
events.description: You ride into a game-style Vice City at golden hour standing on the bow of a speedboat, walk up the beach three abreast as the neon comes on, put on aviators and freeze on your own character intro card.

events.name: It's Time Christmas
events.description: A clock on a black screen ticks to 12:00:00 AM on Halloween night, you scream in a punk Halloween look, frost sweeps over the frame, and you come back in a red Santa outfit on a snowy mountain, the camera pulling back until you stand on top of a giant Christmas tree.

events.name: Kiss Your Phone
events.description: In a bright white kitchen, one of you smiles at a phone and kisses the screen; the other, stirring a pot, throws a bowl of water in their face, grabs the phone and finds their own photo on it.

events.name: Need for Speed
events.description: Your own car stars in a sunny small-town street-racing scene: it cruises past the camera, spins burnouts in thick white tyre smoke while people on a patio stare, and vanishes in a smoky donut.

events.name: Winter Wonderland Dance
events.description: You two in matching Christmas pyjamas doing the Winter Wonderland dance by the tree, one of you walking in with the cat.
